tools.name: scan_business_readiness
tools.description: Scan any business website and report whether AI agents can find, trust, and pay it. Returns pillar scores, a grade, per-check evidence, and a link to the report (it opens for whoever has the link and is not listed anywhere).

tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: Find businesses that sell what the customer needs in the place they name, for example need "espresso beans" and place "Montreal", or need "plumber" and place "H2X". Both are required. Searches businesses published on Orbylon whose owners proved they own their website, by the words of what they sell

tools.name: lookup_business
tools.description: Return the verified identity record for a domain: its domain-bound Ed25519 public key, when it was verified and how, and what it can prove: its signed documents (under capabilities.proofs.list, each with its slug, when it was signed, its SHA-256 and a verify link anyone can open) and a published cat

tools.name: list_business_offerings
tools.description: Return the machine-readable catalogue a verified business publishes. Under owner_provided: who and where the business is, then each item with its name, description, integer price in cents, currency and unit, as the business typed them. Prices are exactly what the business published. An item with pri

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Order an item a verified business publishes (see list_business_offerings or find_businesses). Two steps. First call without confirm: it places nothing and returns the seller, the item, the quantity, the unit price, the full total, the currency, how payment happens, and the refund and cancelling term

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Return what happened to an order placed with place_order: its status, the item, the quantity, the total, and, when the business takes card payment, whether it is paid and the pay_url if not. Takes the business domain and the reference the order answer gave. Never returns the buyer's address, email o

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Ask a verified business for a quote on an item it lists as price on request (price_on_request: true in list_business_offerings): a roofer, a lawyer, a garage. The request is emailed to the business, which replies to the customer with its price. Nothing is paid or owed and no wallet is needed. Ask th

tools.name: list_business_paid_endpoints
tools.description: Return the priced endpoints a verified business publishes: each with its title, what it does, the HTTP method, the price, and the URL to call. Calling that URL returns HTTP 402 with payment terms in the Payment-Required header, and the payment settles directly to the business. A call that fails is n

tools.name: check_business_token
tools.description: Return what is left on a closed-loop token issued by a business through Orbylon: a gift card, prepaid hours, a membership or a points balance. Takes the code printed on the card. The amount left is balance_cents for a gift card (integer cents, in currency), balance_hours for prepaid hours or balance

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_order_status, list_business_paid_endpoints · Private data: lookup_business, request_quote, check_business_token · Public sink: place_order, get_order_status, request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_order_status, list_business_paid_endpoints · Private data: lookup_business, request_quote, check_business_token · Public sink: place_order, get_order_status, request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
